summary: Crinetics Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K reporting antitrust clearance progress for its pending acquisition by Vertex Pharmaceuticals. The merger agreement was signed July 6, 2026, with Clark Merger Sub merging into Crinetics, which survives as a Vertex subsidiary. The HSR waiting period expired August 12, 2026, and approvals from Austria, Germany, and Australia were received, with an Australian waiting period expiring August 27, 2026. A shareholder vote is scheduled for August 28, 2026, with expected close in early September 2026. Watch for shareholder approval and final regulatory timing.
